cognitive_contract.label: Model / strategy choice (Direct application)
cognitive_contract.decisive_act: Choose or formulate the governing model, law, variables, process, or strategy.
cognitive_contract.band_protected_work: Leave one meaningful identification, relation, translation, or execution decision to the learner; support may make the surrounding route explicit.
cognitive_contract.support_posture: Narrow the immediate operation if useful, but do not perform W.

slots.X: which features of the situation determine the model, law, or strategy and which features are irrelevant
slots.Y: a demonstrated model's assumptions, invariants, or selection cues
slots.Z: choose or formulate the governing model and map the situation into it
slots.W: the final model, law, or strategy choice or formulation
slots.wrong_idea: the most familiar model is selected from keywords instead of checking assumptions
slots.replacement_rule: compare candidate models against the stated conditions and choose the one whose assumptions fit
slots.visual_job: surface features that discriminate between candidate models without naming the winning model
slots.check_job: test the chosen model against its assumptions, dimensions, limiting cases, or a plausible alternative model

core2_custody.stem_requirement: Exact question stem requiring choice/formulation of a mathematical model or pattern rule
core2_custody.hint_ladder_requirement: H1 features orientation, H2 candidate model test; preserves W (the final model formulation)
core2_custody.solution_requirement: Locked pre-commit; step-by-step why-valid derivation showing model consistency across all figures
core2_custody.distractor_requirement: Every distractor explained with alternative incorrect model formulations

core1a_declarative.anti_leak_rule: Strict prohibition on leaking Core 2 exact parameters or answers in Core 1A text

core2a_supported_practice.crux_alignment: Identical modeling crux with progressive hints and after-commit unit link
core2a_supported_practice.navigation: Data attribute data-core-unit-id binding to specific topic unit

core2b_transfer.perturbation_rule: Vary numerical inputs while preserving the identical underlying structural model
core2b_transfer.verification: Confirm learner strategy choice W transferred without memorizing specific values

rules.T01_PRECOMMIT_OPTION_STYLING: Pre-commit option styling must not disclose the keyed answer via green borders, classes, or attributes
rules.T02_SUMMARY_ANSWER_LEAK: Summary elements must not disclose the answer letter or key prior to attempt commitment
rules.T03_SOLUTION_PRECOMMIT_UNLOCKED: Solution container must be inert and hidden prior to learner commitment
rules.T04_SCORE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS: Difficulty score must be within [0, 2] for Band D1
rules.T05_CRUX_MOVE_REF_MISSING: Question must declare a valid crux_move reference
rules.T06_KATEX_RENDER_DEFECT: HTML must not contain KaTeX error spans or unescaped macro issues
rules.T07_CORE1A_PARAMETER_LEAK: Core 1A declarative study must not leak Core 2 specific question parameters or answers
rules.T08_CORE1B_PRECOMMIT_ANSWER_LEAK: Core 1B reconstruction must enforce answer_before_attempt: FORBIDDEN
rules.T09_CORE2A_UNIT_NAV_MISSING: Core 2A must provide explicit question-specific unit navigation
rules.T10_EMPTY_HINT: Hints must provide meaningful question-specific guidance
rules.T11_PRECOMMIT_PROTECTED_W_LEAK: Pre-commit hints must not leak protected work W (the final model formulation/value)
rules.T12_CORE_P2_TOPIC_ONLY_NO_QUESTION_UNIT: HTML must target a source-declared question-specific Core1 unit
rules.T13_HINT_PROGRESSIVE_SEQUENCE_MISSING: Hint sequence must progress from H1 conceptual nudge to H2 tactical step
rules.T14_SOURCE_CUSTODY_INTEGRITY: Source question must maintain verified provenance and custody hash
